theater: 義大利北部與羅馬米爾維安橋

battle.name: 法蘭克-東歌德戰爭
battle.theater: 義大利北部與羅馬米爾維安橋
battle.brief: 西元492年，法蘭克王克洛維斯與東哥特王狄奧多里克為爭奪意大利，在羅馬米爾維安橋交鋒，狄奧多里克設伏得手，並圍困拉文納，迫奧多亞克爾降服。此役終結西元476年起的意大利王國，開啟東哥特王國。亞述長矛千年前已定型，是前線長矛祖型；但米爾維安橋上刺穿盾牆的，仍是法蘭克長矛與羅馬標槍。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 法蘭克-東歌德戰爭有兩大交戰集團，外加一個居中操縱的第三方。甲方是克洛維斯一世率領的法蘭克聯盟：核心是薩利安與里普瓦里安兩支法蘭克部族，國王身邊常備數百人的王族戰團（scara），開戰時再按氏族與地域集結步兵與騎兵；此外有阿勒曼尼人、布爾根第人、圖林根人等部族以同盟者身分隨軍，並帶上一批來自高盧南部的羅馬籍士兵與羅馬化地方部隊。乙方是狄奧多里克率領的東哥特聯盟：主力是自潘諾尼亞東來的哥特王室軍，狄奧多里克身邊有一支約二千人的精銳騎兵近衛（comitatus），軍中同時編入格皮德人、汪達爾人等附庸部族；義大利境內原有的斯基里人與北日耳曼傭兵則集結在奧多亞克爾一方，其指揮權集中於拉文納的宮廷與殘存的元老院。東羅馬皇帝澤農是第三方：他先以帝國名義默許狄奧多里克進入意大利，後來派兵支援被圍的拉文納，又以皇帝身分調停雙方停戰，最終倒向狄奧多里克。兩位國王的權力都靠戰團與部族的推舉維持，出征前由全軍大會推舉戰時統帥，這與東羅馬以常備軍和將領銜制為主的體制截然不同。
countriesEn: The Frankish-Ostrogothic War had two great opposing groupings, plus a third party that steered events from the middle. On one side stood the Frankish confederation led by Clovis I: its core was formed by the Salian and Ripuarian branches of the Frankish people, with the king keeping a standing war-band of several hundred men (the scara) around him, and the rest mustered by clan and district as combined foot and horse when war was called; alongside them marched the Alamanni, Burgundinians and Thuringians as allies (foederati), together with a body of late Roman soldiers and Romanised local troops from southern Gaul. On the other side was the Ostrogothic confederation led by Theodoric: the main force was the royal Gothic host that had come east from Pannonia, with about two thousand picked horsemen (the comitatus) at Theodoric's side, and into the host were incorporated subject peoples such as the Gepids and Vandals; in Italy itself the Scirians and other north Germanic war-bands were drawn up under Odoacer, whose command was centralised in the palace and the residue of the senate at Ravenna. The Eastern Roman emperor Zeno was the third party: he first tacitly allowed Theodoric to enter Italy in the name of the empire, later sent troops to support besieged Ravenna, mediated a truce between the two sides in his capacity as emperor, and in the end threw his weight behind Theodoric. The authority of both kings rested on the acclamation of their war-bands and clans, and the war-leader for the campaign was chosen by an assembly of the whole host before the fighting began, a system quite unlike the standing-army regularity and command hierarchy of the Eastern Empire.
people: 法蘭克方面的核心人物是克洛維斯一世。他是西元481年或稍後即位的墨洛溫王朝君主，在父王契得里克留下的薩利安法蘭克部眾中長成，靠與東羅馬的盟約、婚姻與軍事合作維持王位；他的兄弟伽拉戰歿於薩爾布爾克戰役，他的兒子查理貝特與孫子西吉斯蒙德日後也成為他的對手。義大利方面的主角是奧多亞克爾，這位西元476年廢黜末代西羅馬皇帝羅慕路斯・奧古斯都魯斯、自立為意大利王的首領，軍隊主要由斯基里人與北日耳曼傭兵組成。真正的轉折人物是狄奧多里克大帝：東哥特王之子，父王提烏迪梅於西元476年率眾前往意大利時在海灣遭奧多亞克爾的襲擊而身亡，狄奧多里克隨後在潘諾尼亞集結大軍，屢次上表東羅馬，終於取得皇帝澤農的默許而入境。他於西元488年末或489年初越過阿爾卑斯山，兩度在野外擊敗法蘭克大軍，最終攻陷拉文納，建立東哥特王國。文獻方面，約旦的《哥特史》是最主要的戰爭敘述，東羅馬史家普羅科匹烏斯以在君士坦丁堡的見聞記錄拉文納陷落的一夜，馬爾凱利努斯・科米特與普里斯庫斯則可資旁證。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Frankish side was Clovis I. He came to the throne of the Merovingian dynasty in AD 481 or shortly afterwards and grew up among the Salian Franks left behind by his father Childeric, holding the kingship together with the alliance, the marriage ties and the military cooperation he had with the Eastern Empire; his brother Galla was killed at the battle of Saalburg, while his son Charibert and his grandson Sigismund would later become his rivals. The principal actor in Italy was Odoacer, the warlord who in AD 476 deposed the last western Roman emperor, Romulus Augustulus, and ruled as king of Italy: his army was composed mainly of Scirians and north Germanic mercenaries. The turning point was Theodoric the Great, son of the Ostrogothic king Thiudimer: when his father led the Goths towards Italy in AD 476 he was killed in a bay in an attack by Odoacer's men, and Theodoric then mustered a great host in Pannonia, petitioned the Eastern emperor repeatedly, and at last obtained Zeno's permission to enter Italy. He crossed the Alps in the late months of AD 488 or early 489, twice defeated the Frankish army in the open field, and finally took Ravenna and founded the Ostrogothic kingdom. On the documentary side the principal narrative is Jordanes' Getica; the Eastern Roman historian Procopius, who was at Constantinople, records the night of Ravenna's fall, and Marcellinus Comes and Priscus provide corroboration at second hand.
kits: 卡面所繪的亞述長矛成形於西元前九百年前後，是一把短柄、長刃的刺槍：槍身約一公尺二至一公尺五，刃部狹長而略呈柳葉形，鐵鏃安在木杆上，握處纏皮帶，遠征兵團的矛兵以右手持矛、左手持弓與圓盾。亞述人把鐵矛與複合弓綁在同一套體系裡，矛兵列陣封住缺口，弓兵在側翼與車上覆蓋射界，城池因此一個接一個陷落，這正是兵器史上「鐵與弓」的典型組合。但到了西元489至493年的意大利戰場，沒有任何一方使用亞述式短柄長矛，也沒有亞述式複合弓。真正上手的是從青銅時代一路演下來的窄刃矛：法蘭克人用日耳曼式長矛（framea），柄長約一公尺八至二公尺，鏃作細長四棱形，配圓盾與環甲，近身時以戳刺為主；東哥特人用同源的長矛與標槍，盾型偏大而長，紀律與騎兵配合更深地受東羅馬操典影響；奧多亞克爾麾下的羅馬籍僱兵則用羅馬制式標槍（pilum），以軟鐵桿配細鏃，飛行距離長而利於破盾。攻城方面，狄奧多里克在拉文納用圍城器材與海路封鎖斷糧，守軍依靠城牆、弩砲與碼頭的船隊，在物資耗盡後才淪陷。
kitsEn: The piece of equipment on the card is the Assyrian spear, a form that took shape around the ninth century BC: a short-shafted, long-bladed thrusting weapon, its haft roughly 1.2 to 1.5 metres, its blade narrow and slightly leaf-shaped, its long iron point socketed on a wooden shaft, the grip bound with leather, carried in the right hand by the spearmen of the Assyrian expeditions, with bow and round shield on the left. The Assyrians bound iron spear and composite bow into a single system: spearmen held the line to close a breach, archers covered the field of fire from the flanks and from the platform of the war chariot, and cities fell one after another, the classic pairing of iron with bow. But on the Italian field of AD 489 to 493 no side whatsoever used an Assyrian-type short-shafted spear, and no Assyrian composite bow either. What was actually in hand was the narrow-bladed spear that had evolved since the Bronze Age: the Franks used the Germanic spear (framea), about 1.8 to 2 metres long, with a slender four-edged point, round shield and ring mail, stabbing rather than swinging at close quarters; the Ostrogoths used spears and javelins of the same family, with a larger and longer shield, and a discipline and combination of horse and foot more deeply marked by Eastern Roman drill; Odoacer's Roman hirelings used the Roman pilum, with a soft iron shank and a small point, long in flight and effective against shields. In the siege lines Theodoric used siege engines and a blockade by sea to cut off supplies, while the defenders relied on their walls, bolt-throwers and the boats of the harbour, and held out only until their stores were exhausted.
tactics: 意大利戰役的戰術可用三個場合概括。維羅納之戰是正面會戰：克洛維斯以法蘭克騎兵對上奧多亞克爾的聯軍，在山前平原反覆衝鋒，靠正面壓力把敵軍逐向河谷，奧多亞克爾退守拉文納。米爾維安橋之戰是縱深設伏：法蘭克軍沿弗拉米尼亞古道由北而下，狄奧多里克把步兵與弓箭手佈在狹窄橋頭與兩側樹叢，居高臨下封住道路，待法蘭克先鋒進入狹隘才以盾牆與長矛同時壓下，隨即全軍出擊，並在追擊中把法蘭克兵驅回北撤，連追三日。第三是拉文納圍城：狄奧多里克以重步兵封住陸路、以同盟的東羅馬艦隊封住海口，切斷糧水，再以攻城塔與撞錘對城牆開缺口，最終在守軍與東羅馬援軍之間製造倒戈，一舉奪城。整體而言，東哥特方的戰術核心是「以地中海的船與帝國的糧養自己的兵」，法蘭克方則倚仗騎兵的衝鋒速度與部眾的韌性，卻缺乏長期圍城所需的器械與海上通道。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the Italian campaign can be summarised from three situations. The battle of Verona was a meeting engagement in the open: Clovis brought his Frankish horse against Odoacer's allied host on the plain before the mountains, and repeated charges drove the enemy back into the river valleys until Odoacer withdrew to Ravenna. The battle of the Milvian Bridge was an ambush in depth: the Frankish host came down the ancient Via Flaminia from the north, Theodoric posted his infantry and archers at the narrow bridge head and in the thickets on either flank to hold the road from above, and when the Frankish vanguard entered the defile he brought down shield-wall and spear together, then launched the whole army and pursued the Franks back north for three days. The third was the siege of Ravenna: Theodoric sealed the land route with heavy infantry and the sea with the help of an allied Eastern Roman fleet, cutting off food and water, and then worked the walls with siege towers and rams until a breach opened; in the end it was the division between the garrison and the Roman relief that was exploited, and the city was taken in a single stroke. Overall the Ostrogothic method rested on using the ships and the supplies of the Mediterranean to feed one's own troops, whereas the Frankish method relied on the speed of the charge and the toughness of the war-band, while lacking the engines and the sea lanes that a long siege demanded.
data: 這場戰爭的數字大致分為可靠與不可靠兩類。可靠的是年代骨架：法蘭克人於西元488年末或489年初入境意大利，維羅納之戰通常繫於489年6月，拉文納自489年起被圍，至493年3月初陷落。卡面採用的492年繫年屬另一說法：主流編年把米爾維安橋之戰放在489年10月25至26日，部分史家依馬爾凱利努斯・科米特等晚期編年的紀年把它推到490年甚至492年；本卡採後說，戰場繫於米爾維安橋。可靠的還有地理數字：狄奧多里克自潘諾尼亞至亞奎萊亞，陸路約九百公里；米爾維安橋在羅馬西北，沿台伯河上行通往佛羅倫薩；拉文納距羅馬約三百五十公里，位於波河三角洲的沼澤地帶，藉港城克拉西斯的海運通道與外界相連。不可靠的是兵力：後世編年把法蘭克大軍寫成數萬乃至更多，狄奧多里克的哥特軍則寫成一萬上下；普羅科匹烏斯記載東羅馬以五十萬枚金幣付給法蘭克人作為退兵之資，這類數字帶有明顯修辭，應視為量級而非帳目。人數的可靠下限只能從器械推斷：雙方都靠步行重裝步兵與騎兵作戰，而圍城方需配備的攻城塔數目完全無考，故一切精確兵力數字都應存疑。
dataEn: The figures for this war divide into a reliable class and an unreliable one. Reliable is the chronological frame: the Franks entered Italy in the last months of AD 488 or in 489; the battle of Verona is usually put in June 489; Ravenna was first invested in 489 and fell in the first days of March 493. The dating of 492 adopted on this card belongs to another reckoning: the mainstream chronology places the battle of the Milvian Bridge on 25 and 26 October 489, while some historians, following Marcellinus Comes and other late annals, push it to 490 or even 492; this card follows the latter reckoning and ties the field to the Milvian Bridge. Reliable too are the geographical figures: from Pannonia to Aquileia the land route runs about nine hundred kilometres; the Milvian Bridge lies north-west of Rome, and the road up the Tiber leads towards Florence; Ravenna is some three hundred and fifty kilometres from Rome, sitting in the marshes of the Po delta and linked to the outside world by the sea road of the port of Classe. Unreliable are the numbers of men: later chroniclers make the Frankish host tens of thousands and more, and the Gothic army of Theodoric about ten thousand; Procopius records that the Eastern Romans paid the Franks five hundred thousand gold pieces to withdraw, and figures of this kind carry obvious rhetorical inflation and should be read as orders of magnitude rather than as accounts. The only sound lower bound on the numbers has to be inferred from the equipment: both sides fought on foot with heavy infantry and with horse, and there is no record whatever of the number of siege towers a besieger would have needed, so every precise figure for the armies must remain doubtful.
cause: 打起嚟的原因有三層。最深的一層是帝國崩解後意大利的真空：西元476年西羅馬皇帝被廢，意大利在形式上仍掛在東羅馬皇帝名下，實際由奧多亞克爾以蠻族國王的身份治理，羅馬稅制與元老院殘餘仍在運作。第二層是法蘭克的南下壓力：克洛維斯在墨洛溫王朝整合高盧北部之後，需要意大利的稅收、城市與冬季駐地來鞏固王權；法蘭克人並非一開始就打算滅亡意大利王國，而是逐步向波河平原推進。第三層是東羅馬的算盤與東哥特的反制：澤農不希望法蘭克人占據意大利，因為那會讓西歐邊界完全落到蠻族之手；他也需要一支能制衡奧多亞克爾的力量。狄奧多里克於是上表請命，澤農答應讓哥特人進入意大利，卻不授予正式軍籍，也不反對奧多亞克爾自保，等於默許兩方互相消耗。奧多亞克爾不甘坐困，先後襲擊東哥特在潘諾尼亞與達利馬提亞的營地，並殺死狄奧多里克的父親提烏迪梅，這條血債成為狄奧多里克傾力西進的直接動機。最後的導火線是法蘭克大軍越過阿爾卑斯山進入意大利本土，這使奧多亞克爾與狄奧多里克的臨時聯合完全破裂。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason behind the war. The deepest was the vacuum left in Italy by the collapse of the empire: the western Roman emperor was deposed in AD 476, and Italy formally remained under the name of the Eastern emperor while being governed in practice by Odoacer as a barbarian king, with the Roman taxation system and the residue of the senate still functioning. The second layer was the southward pressure of the Franks: once Clovis had knit together northern Gaul under the Merovingian dynasty, he needed the taxes, the cities and the winter quarters of Italy to make that kingship secure; the Franks did not set out to destroy the Italian kingdom, but advanced step by step into the Po plain. The third layer was the Eastern Roman calculation and the Ostrogothic answer: Zeno did not want the Franks to hold Italy, for that would place the whole western frontier in barbarian hands, and he also needed a power able to counter Odoacer. Theodoric petitioned accordingly, and Zeno allowed the Goths into Italy without granting them regular army status and without opposing Odoacer's self-defence, which amounted to letting the two sides wear each other down. Odoacer, unwilling to sit penned in, raided the Ostrogothic camps in Pannonia and Dalmatia and killed Theodoric's father Thiudimer, and that blood-debt became the immediate motive behind Theodoric's drive west. The last spark was the Frankish army crossing the Alps into the Italian peninsula, which broke the Odoacer-Theodoric alliance completely.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接結果，是西元476年建立的意大利王國終結，東哥特王國取而代之，直到西元553年東羅馬收復意大利。制度的延續性遠比想像中強：狄奧多里克保留了羅馬的稅制、官署、城市與教會，羅馬人可保留公民身份，軍隊則以哥特人與羅馬降兵的混成部隊重建。東羅馬皇帝澤農於西元500年把執政官徽與元老院席位授給狄奧多里克，後者的兒子托爾格塔於西元535年取得執政官銜，說明新王權刻意把自己放進羅馬的框架裡。戰爭也確立了西歐的一個新型態：不再是短暫的劫掠與據點式的蠻族營地，而是以羅馬城市為骨架、常備軍與總督制度為中樞、能徵稅能造幣的「新王國」。這條路徑後來被西哥特王國與倫巴德王國重複，成為中世紀拉丁西歐國家的制度底層。在軍事文化上，狄奧多里克的戰法——正面陣線、伏兵與追擊、圍城與海陸並進——是晚期羅馬兵學在西方最後一次成功的實踐，隨後西歐戰爭的重心轉向重騎士與城堡攻防，長矛從前線主兵器退居次要，這正是亞述式長矛譜系的終點之一。
impactEn: The direct outcome of the war was the end of the kingdom of Italy founded in AD 476 and the substitution of the Ostrogothic kingdom, which lasted until the Eastern Romans reconquered Italy in AD 553. Institutional continuity proved far stronger than might be expected: Theodoric kept the Roman taxation system, the offices, the cities and the churches; Roman citizens kept their status, and the army was rebuilt as mixed units of Goths and surrendered Romans. The Eastern emperor Zeno gave Theodoric the insignia of the consulship and a seat in the senate in AD 500, and the king's son Thorismund received the consulship in AD 535, showing that the new kingship deliberately placed itself inside the Roman framework. The war also established a new form in the West: no longer a raid or a camp of a few occupied strongholds, but a kingdom with the Roman cities as its frame, a standing army and a consular administration at its centre, capable of levying taxes and striking coin. That path was walked again afterwards by the Visigothic and Lombard kingdoms, and it became the institutional bedrock of the Latin West in the Middle Ages. In military culture Theodoric's method — a frontal line, ambush and pursuit, siege with pressure by land and by sea — was the last successful practice of late Roman doctrine in the West; after that the centre of gravity in European warfare moved towards heavy knights and the attack of castles, and the spear stepped back from its place as the main close-combat arm, which is one of the end-points of the Assyrian spear's lineage.
result: 戰爭以狄奧多里克的全面勝利告終。維羅納之戰後法蘭克人一度深入半島，但米爾維安橋的伏擊摧毀了克洛維斯的攻勢，狄奧多里克乘勝追擊三日，奪回法蘭克軍的輜重與俘虜，奧多亞克爾的聯軍則退守拉文娜固守。拉文娜圍城歷時近四年，靠陸路封鎖與東羅馬的海上支援維持，最後在守軍與援軍之間出現裂痕，城門在一次內應配合下被打開，奧多亞克爾依約赴宴，隨即被處決，東哥特人接管了整個意大利。澤農皇帝隨即轉向，把原本用來對付法蘭克的東方資源轉送狄奧多里克，後者在西元500年自君士坦丁堡取得執政官榮銜，其子托爾格塔西元535年再度受銜，東哥特王國由是確認為帝國承認的君長之國。對法蘭克方面而言，這場敗仗等於退回高盧，但也解決了他們一時無法解決的問題：意大利的富裕與東哥特的重兵，逼得克洛維斯回頭收拾勃艮第人與西哥特人。西元496年他滅掉勃艮第王國，507年在普瓦捷擊敗西哥特人，完成了對高盧的統一，也把這場戰爭的勝負，變成下一個半世紀高盧政治的伏筆。
resultEn: The war ended in an outright victory for Theodoric. After the defeat at Verona the Franks pushed deep into the peninsula, but the ambush at the Milvian Bridge broke Clovis's offensive: Theodoric pursued them for three days, taking their baggage and prisoners, while Odoacer's allied host fell back on Ravenna and shut itself up there. The siege of Ravenna lasted nearly four years, kept alive by the blockade on the land route and by sea support from the Eastern Empire, and ended only when a split opened between the garrison and the Roman relief, the city gate being carried with the help of an insider, Odoacer coming to a feast as agreed and being put to death there, after which the Ostrogoths took over the whole of Italy. Zeno then changed sides, transferring to Theodoric the Eastern resources that had been meant for the Franks, and in AD 500 Theodoric received the consular honours at Constantinople; his son Thorismund was decorated in the same way in AD 535, and the Ostrogothic kingdom was thereby confirmed as a client kingdom acknowledged by the empire. For the Franks the defeat meant a withdrawal back into Gaul, but it also settled a problem they could not solve at the time: the wealth of Italy and the weight of the Ostrogothic host turned Clovis back upon the Burgundians and the Visigoths. In AD 496 he destroyed the Burgundian kingdom, and in AD 507 he beat the Visigoths at Vouillé, completing the unification of Gaul; the result of this war thus became the prelude to a century and a half of Gallic politics.
